language.name: English
app.title: QualityBound
gui.tooltip.min_vmaf: Minimum SMART quality score. Recommended: 90. It combines each sample's mean VMAF with its worst one-second period; higher values usually increase file size.
gui.label.size_blocked_policy: If Smart analysis predicts VMAF needs a larger file
gui.tooltip.size_blocked_policy: Applies to candidate selection before the full encode. If the completed file exceeds the effective limit, it is preserved and the queue requires a decision.
gui.label.quality_unreachable_policy: If tested candidates miss the VMAF target
gui.label.skipped_output_policy: When Smart analysis skips a file
gui.tooltip.skipped_output_policy: Applies to automatic quality-unreachable skips and Skip choices made after Smart analysis. It does not apply to planning, probe, or validation skips, or to discarded actual-size misses.
gui.value.skipped_output_copy: Copy the source to the planned output path
gui.group.smart_policies: When Smart analysis cannot meet both targets
gui.tooltip.analysis_profile: Controls Smart analysis confidence through timeline scouting, difficult-content coverage, and independent verification.
gui.tooltip.viewing_context: The default uses the stricter high-fidelity quality assumption, including demanding large-display viewing for 4K sources. Choose Standard display only when that viewing condition matches your intended use.
gui.dialog.copy_skipped_title: Copy files skipped by Smart analysis?
gui.dialog.copy_skipped_text:
Copy these sources skipped by Smart analysis to their planned output paths?

{files}
gui.tooltip.encode_workers: Maximum full-file encodes running at once (1-8). Smart analysis still finishes before full encoding. Higher values may contend for CPU, GPU memory, and hardware encoder sessions.
gui.placeholder.source: Select a source file or directory
gui.placeholder.auto_ratio: Leave blank to use codec default ratio
gui.placeholder.default_output: Leave blank to use the default output root
gui.placeholder.encoder_preset: Leave blank to use encoder default
gui.tooltip.encoder_preset_auto: Auto backend uses resolved encoder default preset.
gui.tooltip.encoder_preset_unavailable: Preset choices are unavailable for the current encoder; using the encoder default preset.
gui.tooltip.backend_detecting: Hardware encoder detection is running; only safe backend choices are shown.
gui.tooltip.backend_filtered: Only backends that passed hardware encoder detection are shown.
gui.tooltip.decode_acceleration_unavaila: VideoToolbox decoding is unavailable in the selected FFmpeg build; software decoding is used.
gui.tooltip.smart_unavailable: Smart mode is unavailable because the selected FFmpeg cannot run libvmaf.
gui.placeholder.ffmpeg: Optional override. Leave blank to prefer project-root FFmpeg/ before system ffmpeg.
gui.placeholder.ffprobe: Optional override. Leave blank to prefer project-root FFmpeg/ before system ffprobe.
gui.table.name: Name
